summary.content:
Today's selection covers 78 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 55 on Artificial Intelligence and 16 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: In San Francisco, Some Home Sellers Now Ask for OpenAI or Anthropic Stock
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Felons, Fraudsters Flog Offensive Cybersecurity Startup
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, Krebs on Security, Ars Technica and others
• **Fresh Content**: 44 articles published in the last 24 hours
